messages:
Aisha: Heads up — Muni 19th St shuttle running because a kite got tangled in the OCS wires near 16th. Expect delays on the K/T lines. Saw an alert on the city page: https://sfmta.org/alerts
Tom: Wait, a kite? lol :kite: Are people ok? Any ETA?
transit-bot: MUNI ALERT: 16:45 — K/T lines operating with shuttles between 16th and 24th due to OCS obstruction. https://sfmta.org/alerts
Ben: Yep, I got stuck on a shuttle. No injuries, just a very determined kid and a very tangled kite. :joy:
Priya: If anyone needs a ride uptown I'm near 19th. Can take two people. :wave:
Aisha: Thanks Priya — can you pick me up? My bike's locked at the Hub and the shuttle's packed.
Jules: PSA: bring dry socks. Flooded spot by the 19th stairs made my sneakers soggy this morning. :sweat_drops:
Tom: Also FYI BART app saying minor ripple on Richmond line but shouldn't affect downtown transfers.
Ben: Meme reaction: "Kite vs Transit 2026" (posted image) :laughing:
Aisha: Poll: who is rerouting vs waiting? React with :railway_car: for waiting, :oncoming_bus: for rerouting
Priya: :oncoming_bus:
Tom: :railway_car:
transit-bot: Update 16:58 — crew on scene, estimating 25–40 minute disruption. We'll post again when cleared.
Jules: Anyone want to carpool to the office later? I have an extra seat.
Ben: I'll take it if you don't mind a detour for a coffee stop. :coffee:
Aisha: Thanks all — catching the shuttle now. Ping if you need me to move my bike. :thumbsup:
